newsitem.title: GERMANY: RESEARCH ALERT-SALOMON UPS HANNOVER RE OUTLOOK.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SALOMON UPS HANNOVER RE OUTLOOK.

text.p: Analysts at Salomon Brothers on Wednesday said they had raised their earnings estimates for Hannover Re for this year and next after the reinsurance group reported a 10 percent rise in its 1996 earnings per share.

"The shares' significant outperformance may limit near-term prospects but the valuation remains well supported longer term by a solid operating outlook and shareholder-focused management," Salomon said in a research paper.
"Hannover Re provides a refreshing alternative to Munich Re and Allianz," the paper added, describing Hannover Re as a "low calorie alternative".
Salomon has kept a "buy" recommendation on Hannover Re and raised its 1997 DVFA EPS estimate by seven percent to 7.05 marks and the 1998 estimate by 11 percent to 7.66 marks.
